title: Brainstorm: Objects and Madness SRD import
description: Explore existing SRD importer patterns, refine the design for Objects and Madness tables/rules, and capture user-approved acceptance criteria before implementation.
notes:
Context findings: add fail-closed heading anchors Madness->Objects and Objects->Poisons. Canonical source yields 3 madness tables (10 short-term rows, 10 long-term rows, 12 indefinite rows) and 2 object tables (7 AC rows, 4 HP rows). Madness has clean heading tiers for Going Mad, Madness Effects, and Curing Madness. Objects page 203 is currently row-interleaved because the extractor chooses a 5-item far-right island instead of the supported page gutter; faithful object prose requires a narrow extractor regression fix before parsing. Candidate rule shape: Going Mad, Madness Effects, Curing Madness, and one consolidated Objects rule excluding table rows.
User decision: emit all five prose rules: Madness, Going Mad, Madness Effects, Curing Madness, and Objects.
User approved the proposed design: two fail-closed slices; extractor outlier repair; five deterministic tables; five focused rule records; exact coverage gates; canonical regeneration and documentation.
close_reason: Design approved and persisted on parent feature bead loreweaver-uuk.
